svg.aria-label: World Satellite Map — India View with editable country boundaries
svg.title: World Satellite Map — India View
svg.desc: The original 2048 by 2048 satellite raster is preserved without repositioning or resampling. 257 independent editable country and territory boundary paths have been re-registered to the raster coastline. The boundary layer remains editable. This is a visual map overlay, not a survey-grade GIS dataset.
svg.metadata: MapMotion Studio coded SVG. Raster background supplied by the user. Country geometry: amCharts World (India view), worldIndiaHigh, CC BY 4.0. Boundary source: https://www.amcharts.com/svg-maps/world-india-view/ . License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/ . Country geometry was visually affine-registered to the supplied raster. Raster georeferencing was not independently verified; this is not a precision GIS dataset.
